stable.notes: The Accessibility grant survives updates. COS Control now signs with a stable identity, so the permission you grant once keeps working across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time on this update: toggle COS Control off and on under Accessibility, then reopen it. If a session jump cannot use Accessibility, the pet now opens that Settings pane and says the fix. Pairs with server 6.40.2.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
